title: Memory Stabilizes Spontaneous Particle Aggregation: A Linearized Vlasov--Fokker--Planck Analysis
summary: We perform a linearized stability analysis of the Vlasov--Fokker--Planck equation obtained as the mean-field description of a stochastic spontaneous aggregation model with memory. Memory is represented by a chain of $K$ internal variables. We characterize the spatially homogeneous equilibria and derive a scalar dispersion relation for spatially inhomogeneous perturbations.
